card.name: Is after a drug name, before elimination
card.fires_on: The verb "is" or "are" right after a drug name as subject, mostly tenofovir, in sentences about how the drug is cleared or handled by the body. It is strongest in renal-function and overdosage sections.

modes.description: "is" after a product name before a statement about dialysis, protein binding, or intended use.

card.writes: It seems to prepare adverbs and adjectives like "primarily" or "directly" before passive verbs, though the listed tokens are mostly unclear.
card.plain: It fires on "is" right after a drug's name when the sentence is about to say how the body clears the drug.
